releases.name: CurlyCoder v5.7.4
releases.body:
# CurlyCoder v5.7.4

## Highlights

- Standardized project manifests and plugin metadata to `5.7.4`.
- Improved compatibility and validation across supported AI coding agents.
- Fixed plugin manifest encoding and validation issues.
- Updated Hermes plugin metadata and version consistency.
- Refreshed project documentation and installation guidance.
- Added BlockOnMate as the parent company and technology partner supporting CurlyCoder.

## Validation

- Root test suite: 84/84 passing
- Pi extension tests: 23/23 passing
- CurlyCoder MCP tests: 3/3 passing
- Version consistency checks: passing
- npm package: `@bhardwj-sarvesh-projects/curlycoder@5.7.4`

## Installation

```bash
npm install -g @bhardwj-sarvesh-projects/curlycoder

## Links

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/bhardwj-sarvesh-projects/CurlyCoder)
